title: Security Review: loadng.rs 2026-08-16
description:
Security Review: rust/lichen-core/src/loadng.rs

Focus: injection, buffer overflow, crypto misuse, auth bypass, input validation gaps

## Findings Summary
- P2: 1 (input validation gap)  
- P3: 1 (documentation)

## Review Confidence
- Confidence: 85% (15% chance of missed bug)
- Least confident areas: RERR error_code validity, flags field semantics (need spec reference)
- Would raise confidence if: Had spec document for valid error_code/flags values

## What Is Actually Good
- RREQ hop_limit clamped to MAX_HOP_LIMIT (flood amplification prevention)
- RREP signature requirement prevents unauthenticated route injection
- Sequence number freshness uses correct half-window semantics
- All buffer access is bounds-checked before indexing
- SECURITY: comments document trust boundaries clearly
- Typestate pattern for RouteDiscovery prevents invalid state transitions at compile time
